title: Eiffel Tower 'pollution' prank on a fellow viewer

tellings.quote: I said, "Oh, by the way, your target today is probably not the Eiffel Tower."

plain: In the 1980s, inside a military remote viewing unit (a team that tried to describe faraway targets using only the mind), one viewer says he played a prank on a colleague by planting an image in his head before a session. Army sergeant Lyn Buchanan, who served in the unit, tells it as his own doing: he says he told the colleague, "Oh, by the way, your target today is probably not the Eiffel Tower," which would put the tower in the man's mind and spoil his reading.
